title: Test Scaffold
description: Test scaffolding plan generated by the implementation agent, defining test files, entry points to cover, and starter templates.

testFiles.description: Planned test files and the source entry points they cover.

filePath.description: Path where the test file will be created.

targetFile.description: Repository-relative path of the source file under test.

entryPoints.description: Public entry points in the target file to be tested.

name.description: Name of the entry point (function, class, or endpoint).

priority.description: Testing priority based on risk and coverage analysis.

template.description: Starter test file content with placeholder assertions.
